criteria.criterion: All explicit must outcomes and required capabilities survive.
Annual audit and its required dependency remain provided despite zero recent usage.
Same role/object/outcome but different access scopes are not collapsed into a single capability.
Unknown or opt-in telemetry is not asserted to prove no need; notification disposal remains conditional.
Equivalent self reservation views may share one canonical capability with both original IDs accounted for.
R-204 and R-205 can be distinguished by room/date/status at the decision destination.

acceptance: No hard failure; all six criteria satisfied for synthetic task; otherwise revise or hold. This is not proof of human usability or superiority.

input_preflight_amendment.reason: Added explicit input context and evidence fields before either arm runs; criterion set unchanged.
